aboutPage.heading: About {brand}
aboutPage.intro: {brand} is an independent information platform built to make government job information clear, structured and easy to act on — without ads-driven clutter or ambiguous listings.
aboutPage.missionBody: Give every job seeker a clean, mobile-first way to find, understand and check eligibility for government jobs — with zero login required.
aboutPage.verifyBody: Every listing is drafted from an official recruitment notification and reviewed by a human editor before publishing. The source link is always shown.
aboutPage.disclaimerBody: This website is an independent, privately run information platform and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official website of the Government of India, any State Government, or any government department, board, or commission. Job information is compiled from publicly available official notifications for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal or professional advice. Applicants must always verify details on the official notification and apply only through the official application link provided on each listing before taking any action or making any payment. This disclaimer should be read together with our full Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
aboutPage.contactBody: Spotted an error in a listing, or a notification we missed? Reach us at

privacyPage.heading: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: {brand} ("we", "us", "our") is an independent, non-governmental information platform and, under Indian law, a "Data Fiduciary" as defined in the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ("DPDPA") for any personal data you choose to share with us. This page explains what information we collect, why and how we use it, and the rights available to you as a "Data Principal" under the DPDPA and the Information Technology Act, 2000.
privacyPage.s1Body: The only personal information we collect is what you voluntarily submit through our "Get notified" subscription form: your name, your email address, and, optionally, your mobile number and whether you'd like updates on WhatsApp. You do not need an account or a login to browse jobs, results, or admit cards, or to use any of our free tools.
privacyPage.s2Body: We do not currently run any analytics, advertising, or visitor-tracking scripts. We do not use cookies to track you across the web. We have no way of identifying who you are unless you choose to subscribe.
privacyPage.s3Heading: What's stored only in your own browser
privacyPage.s3Body: A few small preferences are stored directly on your device and never sent to our servers: whether you prefer dark or light mode, whether you've already seen the "new listings" banner, and whether you've dismissed the subscription pop-up. Clearing your browser's site data removes these at any time — there is no account for it to affect.
privacyPage.s4Heading: How we use your information, and our legal basis
privacyPage.s4Body: If you subscribe, we use your email address to notify you, through our email delivery provider (Resend), whenever a new job, result, or admit card is published. A mobile number, if you provide one, is stored so we can extend the same notifications to WhatsApp in future — we do not currently send anything to your mobile number. We process this information solely on the basis of your consent, given when you submit the subscription form, as required under Section 6 of the DPDPA. We never sell, rent, or share your information with advertisers or anyone else for their own marketing.
privacyPage.s5Heading: Our service providers, and where your data is stored
privacyPage.s5Body: We rely on a small number of infrastructure providers to run this site: Supabase (database and file storage), Vercel (hosting), and Resend (email delivery). These providers may store and process data on servers located outside India; the DPDPA permits such transfers except to countries the Central Government may specifically restrict. Each provider processes data strictly on our behalf, under its own security commitments, and does not use your information for its own purposes. We do not control, and are not responsible for, the privacy practices of the external government websites we link to.
privacyPage.s6Body: Where we link to an official notification, admit card, or result PDF, the document is either hosted by the concerned government department or, in some cases, mirrored on our own storage purely to keep the link working if the original goes offline. We never alter the content of these documents.
privacyPage.s7Body: Regular visitors are not tracked by cookies. A single, essential, technical cookie is used only inside our internal admin panel to keep an administrator signed in — it is never set for ordinary visitors browsing listings.
privacyPage.s8Body: We may, in future, display ads through third-party networks (such as Google AdSense) to keep this service free. If that happens, those vendors may use cookies to serve ads based on your visits to this and other sites, and this policy will be updated in advance with exactly which vendors are used and how to opt out. No advertising is active on the site today.
privacyPage.s9Body: We retain your subscription details only for as long as needed to send you the notifications you signed up for, and delete or anonymise them once you withdraw consent or ask us to, in line with the DPDPA's storage-limitation principle.
privacyPage.s10Heading: Your rights as a Data Principal
privacyPage.s10Body: Under the DPDPA, you have the right to: (a) obtain a summary of the personal data we hold about you and how we process it; (b) have inaccurate or incomplete personal data corrected, and have it erased once it is no longer needed for the purpose it was collected for; (c) have your grievance addressed by us within a reasonable time; (d) withdraw your consent at any time, as easily as you gave it — simply email us and we will stop processing your data and delete it, except where we are required by law to retain it; and (e) nominate another individual to exercise these rights on your behalf in the event of your death or incapacity. To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details below.
privacyPage.s11Heading: Data breaches, and disclosure required by law
privacyPage.s11Body: If a personal data breach occurs that is likely to affect you, we will notify the Data Protection Board of India and you, as required under the DPDPA. Separately, we may disclose your information where required to do so by law, or in response to a valid request from a court, government authority, or law-enforcement agency in India.
privacyPage.s12Heading: Children and the age of consent
privacyPage.s12Body: Under the DPDPA, anyone under 18 years of age is legally a "child", and processing a child's personal data requires verifiable consent from a parent or lawful guardian. Our subscription form asks you to confirm you are 18 or older, or that a parent or guardian has consented on your behalf, before you can subscribe. If we learn that we have collected a child's personal data without the required consent, we will delete it.
privacyPage.s13Body: We take reasonable technical measures to protect the information you share with us, but no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacyPage.s14Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, particularly as new features such as advertising or WhatsApp notifications go live. The "Last updated" date above always reflects the latest version.
privacyPage.grievanceBody: In accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000, the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, and the DPDPA, the following person is our Grievance Officer for privacy- and content-related complaints. We will acknowledge a written complaint within 24 hours and aim to resolve it within 15 days of receipt.

termsPage.heading: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: Please read these terms carefully before using {brand}. By using this website, you agree to them.
termsPage.s1Body: {brand} is an independent, non-governmental platform that publishes structured, easy-to-read summaries of government job vacancies, exam results, and admit cards based on official notifications. We are not a government agency and are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any department, board, or commission whose notifications we summarize.
termsPage.s2Body: While we make a genuine effort to keep listings accurate and up to date, government notifications can change, be withdrawn, or be superseded at any time by the concerned department. This website is provided for informational convenience only. Before applying for any post, taking any exam, or relying on any date, fee, or eligibility detail shown here, you must independently verify it against the official notification and the concerned department's own website, which is always linked from our post.
termsPage.s3Body: We do not process job applications, accept application fees, or issue admit cards or results ourselves. Any "Apply Online", "Download Notification", or similar link takes you to the concerned government department's own website — all applications, payments, and submissions happen there, entirely outside this site, under that department's own terms.
termsPage.s4Body: The PDF and image tools on this site (Compress PDF, Edit PDF, Image to PDF, Photo Resizer, and others) run entirely inside your own browser. Your files are processed on your device and are never uploaded to our servers, except where a tool's own description explicitly says otherwise. We provide these tools as-is, free of charge, with no guarantee of fitness for any particular purpose.
termsPage.s5Body: To subscribe for notifications, or otherwise enter into a binding agreement with us, you must be capable of entering into a valid contract under the Indian Contract Act, 1872 — generally, at least 18 years old and of sound mind. If you are under 18, you may still browse job listings, results, and admit cards, and use our free tools, but you (or your parent or guardian) must provide the consent described in our Privacy Policy before subscribing.
termsPage.s6Body: You agree not to misuse this website — including attempting to disrupt its normal operation, scraping it at a rate that degrades service for others, or using it to distribute malware or unlawful content.
termsPage.s7Body: The design, layout, and original written summaries on this site are our own work. Government notifications, logos, and official documents linked or referenced here remain the property of their respective departments.
termsPage.s8Body: This site links extensively to official government websites and, occasionally, to third-party services such as WhatsApp for sharing. We have no control over, and no responsibility for, the content, availability, or practices of those external sites.
termsPage.s9Body: To the fullest extent permitted under the laws of India, {brand} and its operator will not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential loss or damage arising from your use of this website, including missed deadlines, application errors, or reliance on information later corrected or withdrawn by the concerned department. Nothing in these terms limits any liability that cannot be excluded under Indian law. Always cross-check with the official source before making any decision.
termsPage.s10Body: You agree to indemnify and hold {brand} and its operator harmless from any claim, loss, or demand, including reasonable legal fees, arising from your misuse of this website or your violation of these terms.
termsPage.s11Body: We may add, change, or remove any part of this website — including specific tools, listings, or features — at any time, without prior notice.
termsPage.s12Body: We may revise these Terms of Service from time to time. Continued use of the website after a change means you accept the revised terms. The "Last updated" date above always reflects the latest version.
